tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /jo bo sngags kyi bdag po'i g.yang skyabs dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /jo bo sngags kyi bdag po'i g.yang skyabs dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// jo bo sngags kyi bdag po'i g.yang skyabs dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

sngon 'gro'i rim pa la dang po/ bum pa rdzas ldan dang*/ 'o dkar/ thun rdo la sogs 'du byas la/ bdag bskyed zin pa'i rjes su/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs pa'i// las bum dbus su padma nyi ma'i steng*// hūm̐ yig yongs gyur bcom ldan bdud rtsi 'khyil// ljang sngon khro bo'i chas rdzogs phyag gnyis kyis// rgya gram bsnams shing sdigs mdzub zhabs 'dor stabs// ye shes me dpung 'phro ba'i klong du gsal// gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan las 'od 'phros pas// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rab 'byams spyan drangs nas// bum pa'i lhar thim mchod pas mnyes par byas// slar yang thugs kar hūm̐ yig sngon po'i mthar// sngags phreng 'khor zhing sku las dag byed rgyun// babs pas bum pa bdud rtsis gang bar gyur// oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bzla zhing rdo thun la'ang sngags btab la mthar/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ sems can nyon mongs bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo las// rnam par rgyal ba'i mthu stobs thogs pa med// 'jigs byed khro bo'i rgyal po yongs kyi gtso// bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan khro bos bgegs bzlog mdzad du gsol// bum lha 'od zhu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyur// ces bstod/ gnyis pa bgegs rigs rnams la lan chags bsngo ba ni/ snod bor chog zhig gi nang du ngar mi dang ting lo bca'/ yon bdag gi changs bu dang*/ 'bru dkar nag dar tshon/ yos bkra/ yungs lo dang snye ma/ ram pa/ sbang ma/ zho lad/ 'o rul/ ja lo/ sgog btsong*/ phyugs rnams kyi spu rigs/ slas dang zhing gi sa sna la sogs pa glud rdzas rnams tshang bar bkod la/ hūm̐/ nga ni gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin// sprul pa yang sprul khro bo dang*// khro mo'i tshogs kyis gnam sa gang*// ma rung 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsal// hūm̐ nyon cig lan chags bgegs rigs dang*// klu thel bse rag 'gong po rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma len pa'i phyir// thams cad ma lus 'dir 'dus shig

/yid mthun snod kyi nang du ni// glud gtor 'dod yon lnga ldan pa// yig 'bru gsum gyis byin brlabs nas// gang 'dod zad med rang bzhin gyur// thal mo sbyar la/ bde bar gshegs pa gzugs mdzes 'byams klas dang*// 'jigs bral rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// mchog sbyin pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ lan bdun brjod/ gang yang 'dir 'dus 'byung po'i tshogs// dam sri ltog 'gong bse rag dang*// klu thel dbul sri god 'dre dang*// gri bo gri mo rgab 'dre'i rigs// kun kyang rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon// chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs// rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa// dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs// sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// bden tshig bka' las ma 'da' zhig /mchod sbyin glud gtor 'di longs la// tshim zhing dga' mgu ldan gyur cig /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag dang*// tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa'i// lan chags bu lon sha mkhon byang*// so so'i mthun rdzas 'di khyer la// khyim sgo lam srang 'di nyid du// ma gnas rgya mtsho'i pha rol na// gser gyi sa gzhi brdal ba der// myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig /sarba bighnān gatstsha/ glud gtor rgyang ring bar bskyal/ de nas thun gyis bra ba la/ a mṛ ta dang sumbha ni brjod khyim dang phyugs slas rnams la rdo thun brab pa dang*/ gu gul bdug /srung 'khor ni/ hūm̐/ rang nyid gsang bdag thugs ka nas// 'od zer ye shes me dpung dang*// khro chung sprul pa dpag med spros// phyogs mtshams khor yug bar med gtams// oṃ badzra ma hā kro dhā rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐/ gsum pa khyim khrus bya ba las bum thogs la/

me long khrus gsol ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs khrus sngags dang bcas/ bdud bzhi bcom pa'i mthu stobs kyi// ye shes lnga ldan khro bo'i rgyal// bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i byin rlabs kyi// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin las// nyon mongs dag byed chu rgyun gyis// deng 'dir khrus gsol bde legs shog / khrus sngags brjod/ khyim lha phug lha thab lha sogs// 'go pa'i lha dang pha mtshun lha// g.yang gi lha sogs zhing nor lha// deng 'dir khrus gsol= khrus sngags/ gang dag mi gtsang dri ma yis// khyed rnams mnol zhing gud pa dang*// nyams grib ma lus dag gyur cig /deng 'dir khrus gsol= khrus sngags/ gnas yul khang khyim mi nor la// thab mkhon sel yug rme nal grib// zas gos ro bag grib rigs dang*// sdig sgrib bag chags nyes pa'i tshogs// thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig /deng 'dir khrus gsol bde legs shog / khrus sngags dang*/ a mṛ ta dang*/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs sngags brjod bzhin khyim dang nor slas rnams la 'o dkar shug los 'thor bar bya'o// de nas/ sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag= sogs la shtsau ka gsum gyis shis brjod me tog 'thor zhing*/ de nas g.yang sgrub mdun bskyed la 'jug par bya'o/// / ༈ oṃ swasti/ gdod nas kun khyab kun bzang gnyug ma'i gshis// gshis lugs mi g.yo mi pham rgyal ba'i sras// grub pa grub pa kun las ches 'phags pa// rgyal ba kun dngos karma ka de rgyal// zhes mchod par brjod nas/ 'dir sgrub brgyud karma kaṃ tshang gi thun mong min pa'i bka' srung jo bo sngags kyi bdag po'i sgo nas g.yang skyabs bya ba ni/ stegs kyi khar rin po che'i snod du dkar gsum mngar gsum klu sman gyis sbags pa'i g.yang bshos nor bu 'bar ba'i dbyibs can dang*/ mdun du mchod gtor sbrul dkris can/ gzhan yang nyer spyod bdun/

gser skyems/ mda' dar sogs g.yang rdzas spyi mthun gtsang zhing rgya che ba bshams la/ zla ba gang yang rung ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal phur 'dzoms pa'i dus sam gza' skar tshes grangs bzang bar/ rnal 'byor pa sha chang sogs spangs nas khrus dang gtsang sbra ldan bzhin pa'i thog mar skyabs sems spyi ltar sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang mdangs rang rig hūm̐ mthing ka /yongs gyur rgyal kun mthu stobs gcig bsdus pa// bcom ldan gsang ba'i bdag po sku mdog mthing*// zhal gcig spyan gsum khro bo'i chas rnams rdzogs// 'dor stabs phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub// me yi zhags pas log 'dren gzhob thul bsregs// gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od kyis ye shes pa// spyan drangs gnyis med gyur pa'i thugs kar ni// nyi steng hūm̐ mthar sngags kyis bskor bar gyur// oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa na hūm̐ phaṭa// ces ci nus bzlas/ arghaṃ sogs/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa sogs kyis bstod/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi rten rnams bsangs sbyangs shing bskyed pa ni/ oṃ āḥbighnān sogs dang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ rang nyid yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i mdun du phyi mtha'i rgya mtsho chen po la/ nang rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas kyi khang pa rgyan dang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ pam̐ las padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du yi ge phuḥser po/ de 'od du zhu ba las jo bo sngags kyi bdag po/ sku stod mi ru 'dug pa/ sku smad sbrul du 'dug pa/ sku mdog ser zhing rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ gzhon nu mdzes pa'i cha byad can/ dbu la sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs ka dang ldan pa/ sku yis srid pa gsum la khyab pa/ de yi phyi rim pad 'dab brgyad la zla ba'i steng du yi ge phuḥbargyad yongs su gyur pa las/

shar du mtha' yas dkar po utpal 'dzin pa/ lhor padma dmar po padma 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'jog po dmar po dgra st+wa 'dzin pa/ byang du nor rgyas ser po bum pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du pad chen dkar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ shar lhor dung skyong ser po dung phor 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu karko ṭa nag po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rigs ldan dkar po rin po che'i rkyal bu 'dzin pa ste/ thams cad kyang lte ba yan chad khye'u'i gzugs can/ lus smad lto 'gro'i mjug ma dang*/ mgo bo gdengs ka dang ldan zhing*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa/ bka' nyan dang gsung sdod kyi tshul du gnas pa gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs kar me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin du yi ge phuḥgasal ba de las 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab lhun po'i lho phyogs ma dros rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ rol pa'i mtsho bdun la sogs pa nas/ jo bo sngags kyi bdag po la btsun mo sras dang klu chen brgyad sogs 'khor klu rigs bye ba dung phyur dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs par gyur/ hūm̐ ri rab lho phyogs ma dros na// rin chen brtsegs pa'i khri steng nas// klu yi rgyal po sog ma med// klu chen mang po'i 'khor dang bcas// bdag gis mchod phyir spyan 'dren na// dam tshig dbang gis gshegs nas kyang*// rin chen padma'i khri steng du// brjid cing 'gying bar bzhugs su gsol// lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas nas/ oṃ phuḥta phuḥta ma hā kro dha hūm̐/ siddhī siddhi spho ṭa ya hūm̐/ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ hrīḥdzaḥ arghaṃ sogs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer byung ste sngags bdag gi thugs kar 'khor bas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bar gyur/ oṃ phuḥta phuḥta ma hā kro dha hūm̐/ siddhi siddhi spho ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

zhes bzlas/ aṣṭa nā ga sa pa ri wā ra sarba siddhi pha la bhrūm̐/ zhes pa'i bzlas pa'ang bya/ de nas mchod gtor rnams/ bighnan gyis bsangs/ swā bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bhūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ bcud lha dang mi'i longs spyod 'dod pa'i yon tan sna tshogs kyis gang bar gyur/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ḥ lan gsum/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi char bzhin du bab cing dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba skyed par byed pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ a kā ro lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na// lha rdzas dge ba'i mchod gtor 'di// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol// dag gsal dri zhim legs ldan pa'i// dri chab bdug spos me tog sogs// klu rgyal khyod la 'bul lags na// bdag gi las rnams 'grub par mdzod// yid 'ong legs sbyar ro ldan pa'i// sbrang rtsi dang ni shing tog sogs// klu rgyal khyod la 'bul lags na// bdag cag 'khor bcas bkra shis mdzod// phun tshogs dbyibs legs yid 'ong dang*// yid 'dzin sgra snyan rol mo dang*// dri zhim yid 'ong phun sum tshogs// 'bras chen la sogs zhal zas dang*// 'jam mnyen mdzes pa'i na bza' dang*// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bdag gi bsam pa 'grub pa dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar bar mdzod// nā ga rā dza aṣṭa nā ga nā gi sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod nas/ klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyi tshul du gtor ma la zugs nas gsol bas mnyes shing dgyes pa bskyed par gyur/ oṃ phuḥta phuḥta ma hā kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ siddhi siddhi spho ṭa ya hūm̐/

i dam ba ling kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes bdun nam nyer gcig brjod/ oṃ a nan ta ba su ki ta kṣa ka /karko ṭa ka /padma/ ma hā padma/ shaṃ kha pā la/ ku li ka /oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa ā gatstsha ā gatstsha/ ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ti sarba bhur bhu wa phruṃ phu swā hā/ zhes gtor ma phul/ de nas bka' bsgo ba dang phrin las bcol ba ni/ sngags kyi bdag po/ 'jig rten mthu chen srid gsum tshar gcod/ 'gro drug dbang sdud/ khams gsum bdag po/ gsod byed chen po/ sbrul mgo bdun pa/ zur phud lnga pa/ khye'u chung gzhon nu/ gzhon nu mdzes pa/ gzhon nu gtum po/ nag po chen po/ bdud po chen po/ klu rgyal sog ma med/ las mkhan chen po/ g.yog po chen po/ khol po chen po/ sras dang btsun mo/ klu chen brgyad dang*/ gzhan yang sa bdag klu gnyan 'khor tshogs bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs rnams kyis/ mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la/ bdag gi bran po'i tshul gyis shig /bdag gi g.yog po'i tshul gyis shig /bdag gi las mkhan gyi tshul gyis shig /sngags kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag gis bsgo ba bzhin gyis shig /nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra dga' ba dang dgyes par gyur cig / bstod pa bya ba ni/ klu yi rgyal po sog ma med// gser gyi mdog can gzhon nu'i gzugs// sangs rgyas stong gi phrin las mdzad// sngags bdag sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// klu yi rgyal po sog ma med// skal bzang byang chub sems dpa' ste// gzhon nu gtum po sbrul mgo can// phrin las kun 'grub phyag 'tshal bstod// klu yi rgyal po sog ma med// ri rab lho phyogs ma dros na// gzhon nu gtum po mdangs dang ldan// sems dpa' che la phyag 'tshal bstod// rgya mtsho chu klung lteng ka sogs// kun la dbang bsgyur klu chen brgyad// klu rigs bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs// 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces dang*/ hūm̐/ phyag na rdo rje'i bka' nyan gsung sdod pa'i// thugs rje rnam dag pad zla'i gdan steng na// sku mdog dmar ser phyag gnyis thugs kar sbyar// sku la rin chen sna tshogs mdzes pas brgyan// dbu la sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs ka la// brla gnyis lto 'phye'i mjug mas rgyan du dkris// rnal 'byor dbang phyug skyong ba'i gang zag gi

/bar chad sel zhing ci 'dod sgrub po zhes// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i spyan sngar 'dud pa'i tshul// sngags kyi bdag po 'jig rten mthu bo che// srid gsum tshar gcod 'gro drug dbang du sdud// khams gsum bdag po gsod byed chen po ste// sbrul mgo bdun dang zur phud lnga yis brgyan// gzhon nu mdzes pa khye'u chung gzhon nu'i tshul// gzhon nu gtum po nag po chen po ste// bdud po chen po klu rgyal sog ma med// bran po chen po las mkhan chen po ste// khol po chen po thugs rjes g.yog po'i tshul// khyod la 'bul lo mchod pa 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag gi bran dang g.yog por mdzod// las mkhan chen po khol po'i tshul gyis sgrubs// 'dod pa'i don rnams thams cad 'grub par mdzod/ /ces dang*/ g.yang 'gugs ni/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings ye shes chen po'i klong*// 'gyur med mtha' bral zhing khams nas// bla med dkon mchog rin chen gsum// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i lha tshogs kyi// thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa'i rtsal// spyan lnga mngon par shes pa lnga// las bzhi grub pa chen po brgyad// bral smin yon tan bye ba'i tshogs// mchog dang thun mong grub pa gnyis// bsam gyis mi khyab phywa dang g.yang*// bdag dang yon bdag 'di nyid la// dus 'di nyid la bstsal du gsol// steng phyogs 'dod lha rigs drug dang*// gzugs khams gzugs med khams kyi gnas// 'dod pa'i yon tan sna tshogs kyi// longs spyod dpal 'byor phun tshogs dang*// bsam gtan nang gi dga' bde can// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i btung ba la// rtag par spyod pa'i phywa dang g.yang*// sprin phung gtibs pa ji bzhin du// bdag dang yon bdag= /dus 'di= /bar phyogs 'dzam gling las kyi sa// ri gling rol mtsho nyi zlas brgyan// sa chu me rlung 'byung lnga yis// yon tan sra gsher drod dang g.yo// rtsi sman rin chen gter gyi tshogs// ma rmos lo tog dpag bsam shing*// lha klu gnyan gyi pho brang sogs// snod kyi 'jig rten phywa dang g.yang*// sbrang char babs pa ji bzhin tu// bdag dang =

dus 'di= nang bcud skye 'gro'i tshe bsod dang*// dpal 'byor dge bcu spyod pa'i 'bras// khyad par 'khor los bsgyur pa'i srid// mchog gi rin chen sna bdun dang*// nye ba'i rin chen rnam pa bdun/ bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad la sogs// mdor na bcud kyi sems can gyi// longs spyod dpal 'byor phywa dang g.yang*// na bun gtibs pa ji bzhin du// bdag dang = dus 'di= 'og phyogs gdengs can klu yi yul// rgya mtsho che dang chu klung sogs// klu yi pho brang skyed mos tshal// khang bzang nor bu'i khri stan dang*// yid bzhin bsam 'phel nor bu'i rigs// bsam gyis mi khyab spungs pa'i gnas// sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul stobs kyi bdag /'dzam bu'i gling du char gyi rgyun// 'bebs mdzad rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dang*// bram ze gdol pa klu rigs bzhi'i// dngos grub longs spyod phywa dang g.yang*// rgya mtsho 'khyil ba ji bzhin du// bdag dang = /dus 'di= /gzhan yang rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing*// stong gsum stong chen mi mjed khams// gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya sogs// lha klu mi yi dbang po yi// longs spyod tshe dpal bsod nams stobs// 'khor 'das rab 'byams snod bcud kyi// phun tshogs yon tan phywa dang g.yang*// bdag dang = /dus 'di= /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag bcas// tshe dpal ri rab lta bur brtan// snyan grags lha yi rnga bzhin sgrogs// longs spyod dpag bsam 'bras ltar rgyas// chos brgyud chu bo'i gzhung bzhin ring*// bu slob gza' skar grangs bzhin 'phel// klung rta mnga' thang stobs rtsal rgyas// dpal 'byor longs spyod gud med cing*// mi mchog 'khor los sgyur rgyal bzhin// sbyin pa'i phar phyin yongs rdzogs te// gtan bde rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// go 'phang bde blag 'grub pa yi// sdong grogs mgon skyabs dpung gnyen rnams// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// thogs pa med par bsgrub nas kyang*// phrin las phyogs mthar rgyas par mdzod//

ces brjod/ grangs bsags na mchod gtor byin rlabs man chad mthar chags su 'don/ grol nyin g.yang gtad bya ba'am min kyang gtor ma mdzod du sba zhing*/ hūm̐/ gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' sdod che// las mkhan jo bo mthu chen sngags kyi bdag /yab yum sras 'khor sprul dang yang sprul rnams// mchod bstod las kyis dgyes pa bskang ba'i mthus// 'khor 'das rab 'byams stong gsum 'jig rten gyi// lha klu mi yi tshe dpal bsod nams dang*/ phywa g.yang dngos grub bsam gyis mi khyab kun// deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag la bstsal nas kyang*// 'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par yul phyogs 'dir// lo dgra btsa' sad ser ba 'bu srin sogs// rtag par rgyun chad char chu dus su 'bebs// lo legs skya rgyal 'bru rnams 'phel bar mdzod// mi rnams btsan phyug dpa' zhing rta rnams mgyogs// rkang bzhi gnag lug 'phel zhing rgyas pa sogs// yid la re ba'i 'bras bzang rdzogs pa dang*// las bzhi'i phrin las gang brtsam myur 'grub cing*// mi mthun g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba yi// rgyal mtshan mi nub srid mthar sgreng bar mdzod// rgyal ba'i bstan pa lung dang rtogs pa'i chos// phyogs dus kun tu nub med dar zhing rgyas// khyad par sgrub brgyud karma kaṃ tshang gi /bstan dang brgyud pa'i bstan 'dzin bu slob tshogs// thugs kyi bzhed pa'i don rnams lhun grub cing*// chos dang longs spyod 'khor slob rgyas par mdzod// mdor na bdag gis ci ltar bcol pa'i las// ma lus gegs med myur du 'grub pa yi// phrin las dus la bab po dam tshig can// rig 'dzin chen po padmā ka ra dang*// grub mchog karma pakṣi'i spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam bca' de bzhin du// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces dang*/ me tog 'thor bzhin bkra shis brjod pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen chos dbyings dag pa'i mkhar// tai lo pa sogs bka' brgyud grub brnyes kyi// rnam 'phrul nyi zla'i 'od zer 'bum spro bas// gdul bya'i pad tshal rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog

/thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i rgyud sde bzhi'i// rgya mtsho mchog las rim gnyis nor bu gang*// skal ldan ded dpon dag gis gus blangs pas// mchog thun dngos grub kun stsol bkra shis shog /ye shes sgyu ma'i rol pa mtha' yas kyi// rdo rje'i me char drag po rtag 'bebs pas// log 'dren 'thag byed chos srung rgya mtsho yi// myur mgyogs phrin las zab mo'i bkra shis shog /bdud bzhi las rgyal rgyal ba'i phrin las pa// karma pa bstan bstan pa'i snying po ni// phyogs mthar kun khyab khyab cing rgyun mi chad// rtag par rab 'phel 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog / ces sogs brjod de sbyin bdag rang gnas su btang*/ phye mar drangs/ g.yang rdzas rnams mdzod du sbas te phyi la mi 'khyar ba bya/ rjes ni/ arghaṃ sogs/ bstod par 'os pa sogs/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ lha rnams nongs pa gang mchis bzod par gsol// sogs dang*/ bsngo ba smon lam gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// smras pa/ sbyin pa'i 'bras rab rdzogs byas nas// srid pa'i khams kun gtong min pa'i// gtan bde'i dbyig gi char chen gyi// 'dod gter bum pa bzang po'o// zhes pa'ang sgrub brgyud mchog gi ring lugs la mi phyed pa'i 'dun pa dang ldan pa karma bde dga' zhes byas bskul ngor/ si tu padma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba phyogs dus kun tu dge legs dpal yon yongs su rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga lam/// /
